settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tune how the agent behaves, how long sessions live, and how Telegram messages are handled.
settings.sessionSectionDescription: Control how long conversations stay warm before they are summarized and closed.
settings.sessionTimeoutHint: After this many minutes of inactivity, the current session is summarized and reset. 0 disables the timer.
settings.sessionSummaryProviderHint: Choose a specific provider/model for session summaries, or use the active provider. Useful for using a smaller/cheaper model.
settings.languageSectionDescription: Decide whether the agent follows a fixed language or mirrors the user's language automatically.
settings.languageHint: This setting is injected directly into the system prompt and applies immediately.
settings.timezoneHint: The current date and time in this timezone are included in the system prompt so the agent always knows when it is.
settings.activeProviderHint: The active provider and model used for all chat conversations. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.thinkingLevelHint: How much the chat agent should reason before responding. Higher levels are slower and more expensive. Ignored by models that don't support reasoning.
settings.backgroundThinkingLevelHint: Reasoning level for background task agents, loop detection, fact extraction, memory consolidation, and session summaries.
settings.agentSectionDescription: Fine-tune health monitoring and message batching for connected channels.
settings.healthMonitorEnabledHint: When enabled, the agent periodically checks provider health and can fail over to a fallback provider. Status indicators and dashboard widgets are hidden when disabled.
settings.healthMonitorHint: Defines how often provider health checks should run.
settings.healthMonitorFallbackTriggerHint: When to activate the fallback provider.
settings.healthMonitorFailuresBeforeFallbackHint: Consecutive failures required before switching to fallback.
settings.healthMonitorRecoveryCheckIntervalHint: How often to check if the primary provider has recovered.
settings.healthMonitorSuccessesBeforeRecoveryHint: Consecutive successes required before switching back from fallback.
settings.healthMonitorNotificationsDescription: Choose which status transitions trigger a notification.
settings.batchingDelayHint: Telegram messages received inside this window are grouped before the agent responds.
settings.telegramSendVoiceReplyHint: Send the agent's reply as a voice message in addition to the text.
settings.telegramSendStallWarningsHint: Notify in Telegram when the provider stops responding. Off by default — error messages and the retry button are always delivered.
settings.telegramSectionDescription: Manage the bot token used by the Telegram integration.
settings.telegramEnabledHint: When enabled, the bot connects to Telegram and responds to messages.
settings.telegramBotTokenHint: Leave empty to disable the configured token or replace it with a new one.
settings.telegramUsersDescription: Manage which Telegram users are allowed to interact with the bot.
settings.telegramUsersEmpty: No Telegram users yet. Users appear here after they message the bot.
settings.telegramUsersDeleteConfirm: Remove Telegram user "{name}"? They will appear as pending again if they message the bot.
settings.agentRulesDescription: Define how the agent should behave, communicate, and execute tasks. The agent reads these rules on every conversation.
settings.heartbeatTasksDescription: Define periodic tasks for the agent to execute during each heartbeat cycle.
settings.consolidationRulesDescription: Define what the nightly memory consolidation should focus on — what to promote, update, or ignore.
settings.tasksGuidelinesDescription: Generic guidelines injected into every background task's system prompt. Applies to create_task, cronjob 'task' runs, heartbeat-spawned tasks, and consolidation-spawned tasks.
settings.consolidationSectionDescription: Automatically review daily memory entries and promote lasting insights into core memory (MEMORY.md).
settings.consolidationEnabledHint: When enabled, a daily job reviews recent daily entries and updates core memory if needed.
settings.consolidationRunAtHourHint: Hour of the day (0–23) when the consolidation job runs. Uses server local time.
settings.consolidationLookbackDaysHint: Number of past days of daily memory to review in each run.
settings.consolidationProviderHint: Choose a specific provider/model for consolidation, or use the active provider.
settings.factExtractionSectionDescription: After a session ends, extract durable facts from the transcript and store them for later retrieval via search_memories.
settings.factExtractionEnabledHint: When enabled, the server extracts durable facts from ended sessions and stores them in memory.
settings.factExtractionProviderHint: Choose a specific provider/model for fact extraction, or use the active provider.
settings.factExtractionMinSessionMessagesHint: Only sessions with at least this many messages will trigger fact extraction.
settings.storageSectionDescription: Housekeeping for files users upload through chat.
settings.uploadRetentionHint: Delete uploaded files automatically after this many days. Set to 0 to remove them immediately on cleanup.
settings.nowSetSectionDescription: How many strands can be in play at the same time.
settings.nowSetMaxHint: Upper bound for the now set ({min}–{max}, default 4). Lowering it never removes strands that are already in the set — it only refuses further additions until the set fits again.
settings.resilienceSectionDescription: How the agent reacts to provider errors and stalled responses.
settings.retryEnabledHint: Retry a turn automatically after a transient provider error (rate limits, server errors, timeouts, stalls). Default: on.
settings.retryMaxRetriesHint: How often a failed turn is retried before it ends in an error message. Default: 3.
settings.retryBaseDelayHint: Delay before the first retry, doubled for each further attempt (default 2000 ms). Current schedule: {schedule}.
settings.watchdogStallWarnHint: Show a warning in the chat when the provider has sent nothing for this long. Default: 30000 ms.
settings.watchdogStallAbortHint: Abort the attempt when the provider stays silent for this long. Counts as a retryable error. Default: 90000 ms.
settings.watchdogStallAbortInvalid: The abort threshold must be greater than or equal to the warning threshold.

settings.agentHeartbeatEnabledHint: When enabled, the agent periodically runs maintenance tasks defined in HEARTBEAT.md (memory updates, hygiene checks).
settings.agentHeartbeatIntervalHint: How often the agent runs its periodic maintenance cycle.
settings.agentHeartbeatNightModeDescription: Pause heartbeat during nighttime hours to save costs and avoid unnecessary processing.
settings.agentHeartbeatNightModeEnabledHint: Skip heartbeat cycles during the configured quiet hours.
settings.agentHeartbeatNightModeHoursHint: Uses the timezone configured in Agent settings.
settings.secretsSubtitle: Environment variables that are encrypted at rest and injected into the agent process at startup. Tools like gh CLI automatically pick up tokens set here.
settings.secretsValueHint: Leave empty to keep the existing value.
settings.secretsSaveSuccess: Secrets saved and injected into environment.
settings.secretsDeleteConfirm: Remove secret "{key}"? The environment variable will be unset immediately.
settings.secretsEmpty: No secrets configured yet. Add environment variables like GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN to make them available to all tools.
settings.secretsNewValueHint: Enter a value to set or update this secret.
settings.secretsKeyExists: A secret with this key already exists.
settings.secretsKeyInvalid: Key must be uppercase letters, digits, and underscores (e.g. GH_TOKEN).
settings.tasksGeneralHint: Default behavior for all background tasks and cronjobs.
settings.tasksDefaultProviderHint: Choose a specific provider/model for tasks, or use the currently active provider.
settings.tasksMaxDurationHint: Maximum runtime for a single task. Tasks exceeding this limit are automatically killed.
settings.tasksTelegramDeliveryHint: Control when task results are sent via Telegram. Auto suppresses notifications when you have the web chat open.
settings.tasksLoopDetectionHint: Detect when a background task agent is stuck repeating the same failing action.
settings.tasksLoopDetectionEnabledHint: Automatically detect and stop stuck task agents.
settings.tasksLoopDetectionMethodHint: Systematic checks for repeated identical errors. Smart uses an LLM to evaluate progress.
settings.tasksLoopDetectionMaxFailuresHint: Number of identical consecutive errors before a loop is detected.
settings.tasksLoopDetectionSmartProviderHint: Select a fast/cheap LLM provider for loop evaluation.
settings.tasksLoopDetectionSmartIntervalHint: Run LLM-based detection every N tool calls.
settings.tasksStatusUpdatesHint: Receive periodic progress signals while a background task is still running.
settings.tasksStatusUpdatesEnabledHint: When on, running tasks emit a progress line to your chat (and Telegram when delivery is configured) at the interval below. Off by default.
settings.tasksStatusUpdateIntervalHint: How often a running task emits a progress line with its duration, tool-call count and token usage.
settings.ttsSubtitle: Read agent responses aloud using AI-powered text-to-speech.
settings.ttsEnabledHint: Show a play button on assistant messages to read them aloud.
settings.ttsProviderHint: Choose which AI provider generates the speech audio.
settings.ttsOpenaiModelHint: gpt-4o-mini-tts is the fastest and most expressive. tts-1-hd has higher audio quality.
settings.ttsOpenaiVoiceHint: Select a voice preset for speech generation.
settings.ttsOpenaiInstructionsHint: Optional tone/style instructions (e.g. "Speak in a calm, friendly tone"). Only supported by gpt-4o-mini-tts.
settings.ttsOpenaiInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Speak in a calm, friendly tone
settings.ttsMistralVoiceHint: Select a Voxtral TTS voice preset.
settings.ttsResponseFormatHint: MP3 for general use. Pick Opus when sending replies to Telegram so they render as native voice messages instead of audio attachments.
settings.ttsProviderGeminiNone: Google Gemini TTS (no Google provider configured)
settings.ttsGeminiIntro: Gemini speaks German natively and takes stage directions in plain language. The API key comes from the selected Google provider.
settings.ttsGeminiModelHint: 3.1 Flash TTS is the current model. The 2.5 variants stay selectable for comparison.
settings.ttsGeminiVoiceHint: One of the 30 prebuilt Gemini voices. Charon (informative) and Kore (firm) sound most neutral in German.
settings.ttsGeminiStylePlaceholder: e.g. Speak calmly, clearly and at a normal pace:
settings.ttsGeminiStyleHint: Prepended to the text as a stage direction. Leave empty for the neutral default reading.
settings.ttsResponseFormatGeminiHint: Gemini returns raw PCM. Opus (Ogg) for the app and Telegram voice notes, WAV only if a consumer cannot play Opus.
settings.ttsPreviewPlaceholder: Type text to preview the voice...
settings.ttsPreviewHint: Test the selected voice and mood before saving.
settings.ttsPreviewBlocked: The browser blocked automatic playback. Click “Play now”.
settings.ttsPreviewUnsupported: This browser cannot play the audio format. Pick another format below (e.g. WAV or MP3).
settings.sttSubtitle: Transcribe audio to text using AI-powered speech recognition.
settings.sttEnabledHint: Allow audio transcription via the configured STT provider.
settings.sttProviderHint: Choose which service transcribes audio to text.
settings.sttWhisperUrlHint: Full URL of a Whisper-compatible transcription endpoint (e.g. faster-whisper-server).
settings.sttOpenaiModelHint: OpenAI model used for audio transcription.
settings.sttOllamaModelHint: Name of the Ollama model to use for transcription.
settings.sttRewriteEnabledHint: Use an LLM to remove filler words, repetitions, and spoken artifacts from the transcript.
settings.sttRewriteProviderHint: Choose which LLM provider cleans up the transcribed text.
settings.sttDeepgramModelHint: Deepgram STT model. `nova-3` is the current production model. See developers.deepgram.com for the full list.
settings.sttDeepgramLanguageHint: Single ISO 639-1 code (e.g. `en`, `de`). Use `multi` to let Deepgram auto-switch between languages within one recording (Nova-2 / Nova-3). Comma lists are not supported by Deepgram. Leave empty to auto-detect from the agent language.
settings.ttsDeepgramModelHint: Deepgram Aura voice model used for synthesis.
settings.deepgramApiKeyHint: Leave the masked value to keep the existing key.
settings.multiPersonaDescription: Enable support for multiple Telegram bots with their own personas. Each bot gets its own persona files under /data/agents/[id]/ and isolated sessions + memory.
settings.multiPersonaEnabledHint: When enabled, each Telegram bot can have its own persona, sessions, and memory.
settings.multiPersonaDefaultAgentIdHint: The default agent ID for the main bot (usually "main").

form.actionTypeTaskHelp: Spawns a full background agent with tools and capabilities. Best for complex work like research, file operations, or builds.
